import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    w = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    ok = True
    while m > 0:
        rem = m % w
        if rem == 0 or rem == 1:
            m //= w
        elif rem == w - 1:
            m += 1
        else:
            ok = False
            break
    print("YES" if ok else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
